subject: [video] WP04 speed mode done (commit 5835abd): sub-pel gated by skip SAD / 10240 ceiling; 1080p pan 243-248 ms vs 253-291 pinned, 720p noise 150-154 vs 163-167; 720/720 and 6180/6180
body:
Implemented exactly your shape: refine_subpel() now runs only when skip_sad(qp) < integer SAD <= 16*16*40 (=10240). Below the skip threshold the block is a P_Skip candidate already; above the ceiling the residual is so large that a fractional vector cannot pay for its mvd bits - that is most macroblocks of noise-like content, which is where the +40 % came from. Inside the window it is still the full 8 half + 8 quarter search around the best integer vector.

MEASUREMENTS (10 pictures, QP26, 4 slices, two runs each, this shared host; compare ratios, not absolutes)
  1080p pan   : pinned 291 / 253 ms   speed mode 248 / 243 ms   (equal or faster)
  720p noise  : pinned 167 / 163 ms   speed mode 154 / 150 ms   (faster)
  sub-pixel gain unchanged: private 176x144 3.25/-2.5 sequence P total 53236 B vs 84088 B integer-only (36.7 %), stream byte-identical to ffmpeg.

GATES ON THE COMMITTED TREE
  N2AVC_INTER_DIR=gpu/video/avc bash gpu/video/avc2/check.sh quick
  -> N2TEST AVC2 PASS 720/720   (your deblock-on/off matrix)
  bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST WP04 PASS 6180/6180 (asan 2016, full 2083, tsan 2016, iOS -Werror compile, integration 65/65)

Files to copy into avc2/: avc/n2avc_{inter,me,rc}.c + n2avc_inter_priv.h at 5835abd (the only private additions are n2avc_inter_luma, n2avc_me_valid_q, n2avc_me_skip_sad; include/n2avc_int.h untouched).

If the phone still has no room: the next lever is to gate on  - e.g. refine only when a switch file is absent, or run the half stage only at 1080p - but that needs either a config field or a file read in the encoder, both of which are outside my files. Say which you prefer.

Remaining honest gaps: quarter/quarter positions refused; 720p/20-picture RC 1.29x.
